newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Privatisation has succeeded in joint ventures but remains slow in government establishments in Jordan, study shows.
- United Arab Emirates insurance companies expected to post 1996 record net profits.
- Iraq's oil-for-food deal helps provide 81 percent of Baghdad's food needs.
- Spanish Uniban bank to meet soon to approve its merger with Morocco's leading Wafabank.
- Two Egyptian firms plan to set up 2.4 billion sterling pound fertilising company with annual production capacity of 1.3 million tonnes.
- Seven Jordanian banks expected to grant shares worth $102.6 million after cancellation of taxes on shareholders' capital.
